text_block_list.text:
On my day off, as part of some volunteer work,
I was teaching kids how to make sweets,
when I noticed a child standing alone in the corner—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter?
It looks like you haven't touched it yet.
Is there any problem?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
12 minutes and 31 seconds have already elapsed since we started.
If there is anything you find difficult, I will assist you,
so please feel free to give it a try without feeling pressured.

text_block_list.name: Quiet Child
text_block_list.text:
............
There are... lots, so it's fine.

"She seems interested, but struggles with joining the group.
Most likely, she's nervous as well.
In that case, rather than forcing an invite—"
choice_data_list: You're welcome to join in whenever you like.

text_block_list.text:
With a look of relief, the child nodded.
There didn't seem to be a problem, but it's best to keep an eye on them.
choice_data_list: I'll share some with you once it's finished.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, indeed.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Now, it is finished. Excellent work, everyone.
Teezeit. Let us brew some tea
and enjoy it fresh right away.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Child
text_block_list.text:
It's so good!!
The one I made is number one!!

text_block_list.name: Brisk Child
text_block_list.text:
“Mine's way tastier!
And it looks pretty too!”

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. What a lovely smile.
...Oh, that reminds me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The cookies are ready.
I made them myself...
Would you like to have some with me?

text_block_list.name: Quiet Child
text_block_list.text: ...Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, of cou—

text_block_list.name: Energetic Child
text_block_list.text:
"No fair!!
That one didn't make anything, that's cheating!"

At the sound of that voice, the quiet child
pulled back the hand they had reached out
toward the cookie. And then—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Everyone.
Did you have fun making sweets?

text_block_list.name: Participating Children
text_block_list.text: That was so fun!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Child
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I squished and kneaded it a bunch,
and made cars and cats and stuff!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad. But honestly, seeing someone
enjoy the food I cooked brings me
just as much joy.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
How about this: I will give you my cookie,
so could you please give one of yours
to this child?

text_block_list.name: Energetic Child
text_block_list.text:
You'll give me your cookies, big sis!?
Hmm... okay then.
Here, you can have this.

text_block_list.name: Quiet Child
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you...
I was surprised. I thought Eishin Flash would lecture them much more strictly... When I voiced this—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...The confusion and nervousness of trying new things.
The attachment and pride in what I've worked hard for.
Those exist within me as well."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: However, that isn't necessarily a bad thing. Hesitation is a period of mental preparation. Obsession sparks effort. Even if it seems negative, it can serve as fuel for growth.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Or so my mother taught me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, is that so?
I'm very glad to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Quiet Child
text_block_list.text:
It's delicious...!
Wow, you're so good at this...!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Child
text_block_list.text:
...! Right?! I made it myself!
There's more over there! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Quiet Child
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
choice_data_list: Both of you are smiling now.
Both of you are smiling now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Sweets have the power
to bring out smiles, after all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Everyone can smile and laugh together without distinction.
...That is why I love baking sweets.

Watching the children munch on the cookies,
Eishin Flash wore a gentle smile on her face.
